create_graph_visualizer: create a GraphVisualizer to visualize graph prediction datasets from tf.data.Dataset objects
build_graph_visualization: build a graph visualization from a tf.data.Dataset with customizable node and edge colors
test_graph_visualizer_match: test the GraphVisualizer match method to check if a dataset supports graph visualization
review_graph_visualizer_show: review the GraphVisualizer show method to display graph examples with networkx rendering
summarize_make_edge_getter_fn: summarize the _make_edge_getter_fn helper to extract edges from graph dataset examples
